RSS Chief Mohan Bhagwat to Engage Students in Mumbai

Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat is scheduled to interact with over 2,000 high school students aged 15 to 19 from more than 100 cities across India. The event will take place on August 6 at the Ambani Centre in Mumbai. This outreach aims to connect with Gen Z and Gen Alpha generations. Dipankar Bhattacharya has questioned the RSS's planned interaction.
